findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_price_quote, get_state_hoa_rules, get_review_record, start_election_draft, get_election, create_election_draft, add_voters, remove_voters, publish_election · Private data: get_review_record, create_election_draft, update_election_draft, remove_voters · Public sink: get_price_quote, start_election_draft, get_election, get_election_readiness, get_election_price, add_voters, remove_voters, create_survey, publish_election · Destructive: get_review_record, get_governance_center_overview, update_election_draft, remove_voters.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_price_quote, get_state_hoa_rules, get_review_record, start_election_draft, get_election, create_election_draft, add_voters, remove_voters, publish_election · Private data: get_review_record, create_election_draft, update_election_draft, remove_voters · Public sink: get_price_quote, start_election_draft, get_election, get_election_readiness, get_election_price, add_voters, remove_voters, create_survey, publish_election · Destructive: get_review_record, get_governance_center_overview, update_election_draft, remove_voters

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
